editorial.blurb: A beloved Hyde Park institution that's been serving up casual, unpretentious comfort food to students and locals for decades—think great sandwiches, pizza, and hearty soups in a laid-back, lived-in space.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the grolloveggie or Cajun mahi sandwich, and don't miss the beef chili soup—arrive casual and ready to linger, as this is quintessential neighborhood hangout food meant for sharing and taking your time.
